integrity: Mathematical proof and standalone exact finite cross-checks; historical priority subject to undiscovered equivalent formulations.
scientific_limitations: Standard Catalan matroid incidence realization and its unweighted one-skeleton only. The result describes local degrees, the full degree enumerator and equality cases; it does not establish novel mixing times or eigenvalues. Exhaustive finite checks reach semilength nine; all-size claims follow from the stated combinatorial proof.
title: Depth-two forest statistics determine every vertex degree of Catalan matroid polytopes
